title: Ad Studio overview on Ad Studio

facts.fact: Spotify's Ad Studio is described by Spotify as its self-serve advertising platform for building audio or video ad campaigns.
facts.quote: Ad Studio is Spotify’s self-serve advertising platform. With Ad Studio you can:

facts.fact: Spotify states that a campaign in Ad Studio can be launched with a minimum budget of 250.00 in the advertiser's local currency.
facts.quote: Launch a campaign with a minimum budget of 250.00 in your local currency

facts.fact: Spotify states that using Ad Studio requires a Spotify account.
facts.quote: You’ll need a Spotify account to use Ad Studio.
